gates.title: Firebase Analytics Explore verification
doneWhen: A temporary fixed-enum-only Explore is created under explicit approval.
Android-only safe event rows are verified and the temporary Explore is removed.

gates.title: Production API migration and deploy
doneWhen: The production workflow is registered on protected main and the android-api-production environment has required reviewers, self-review prevention, protected-branch policy, the exact secret/variable names and a safe release arm; a redacted C120 read-only preflight is retained.

The exact Production workflow uses full-SHA official Node 24 actions, contents-read-only authority and non-persistent checkout credentials, and the exact API CI/API E2E runs have zero action-runtime deprecation annotations under C121.
Incoming SSL enforcement is enabled in an approved database restart window, then C98 verify-full preflight passes with count-only output on the production target.
The controlled migration and API deploy finish once, then C98 postdeploy and Android API smokes pass.

gates.title: Real mutation interruption recovery
doneWhen: Approved disposable PRN and inventory operations are interrupted after request transmission.
Refresh and same-intent retry prove one server effect without automatic replay or ambiguous UI success.

gates.title: Production App Links and Android FCM
doneWhen: The canonical assetlinks endpoint and Play-installed domain verification pass with the app-signing certificate.
Android token registration and FC-002 through FC-010 delivery, privacy, routing and cleanup rows pass.

gates.title: Play Organization account, signing and exact AAB handoff
doneWhen: A release-owner-controlled Play Organization developer account is verified against matching D-U-N-S, legal/payment-profile identity, website and contact details, then the exact production package is created.
The owner-managed upload key and independent Play certificate identities pass every fail-closed signing gate.

The generatedapks.list response requested for the exact C114/C116 version has the exact App Links app-signing certificate set, keeps it disjoint from the upload certificate and retains a secret-free C117 receipt.
One generatedapks.download base-master APK per C117 signing key has the exact production package/version/signature bytes and retains a path-free C118 receipt.
The exact clean-commit AAB, schema-v2 ledger with reverified ordered store hashes and SHA256SUMS three-file handoff is retained unchanged.

The Play Developer API Bundle response for the selected upload has the same versionCode and upload-payload SHA-256 as the retained handoff, and its secret-free receipt is retained outside that handoff.

gates.title: Play Internal install and update verification
doneWhen: The exact handoff AAB is processed and installed from Play Internal with Play app signing.

The applications.tracks.releases.list response for qa contains the exact C114 versionCode once with RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_PUBLISHED, a fresh inspection edit's edits.tracks.get response contains it once with completed status, and the secret-free chained receipt is retained.
The generatedapks.list response for that exact version contains base-master split metadata under the expected Play app-signing certificate set and its C117 receipt is retained.

One generatedapks.download base-master APK per C117 signing key passes exact package, versionCode, versionName, ZIP, DEX and embedded-signature verification, and the path-free C118 receipt is retained.

The physical Play-installed package has Google Play installer identity, an exact C118 base.apk byte match, matching version/signing set, at least one optimized split and verified canonical App Links, and its serial/path-free C119 receipt is retained.
Fresh install, prior-version update, App Links, sessions, notifications and package identity pass on the exact artifact.
gates.backlogTitle: Play Internal install and update verification

gates.title: Old-supported and Google-reference physical devices
doneWhen: The required API 26-28 physical target passes its applicable release matrix rows.
A current Google-reference physical target passes its applicable exact-Play-artifact rows.

gates.title: Assisted spoken TalkBack traversal
doneWhen: One-finger focus, spoken order, double-tap activation and two-finger scrolling pass across both role flows.
No hidden, clipped, duplicate, blank or sensitive announcement remains on the exact Play artifact.

doneWhen: Current SDK disclosures and the exact signed artifact are reconciled with the worksheet.
The verified legal organization identity is present in the public privacy policy and the dedicated /account-deletion URL passes the release-mode contract.
The deterministic renderer reproduces the committed source-bound Japanese listing screenshots byte-for-byte, and all eight current surfaces match the signed build in Play preview.
Data safety, Health apps, account deletion and store declarations are submitted and recorded.

Closed testing, crash and ANR review complete with no unresolved P0 or P1 defect.
The exact final commit passes the immutable Node 24 Android CI runtime contract and hosted Android CI without an action-runtime deprecation warning.
The exact final commit passes the full-SHA Node 24 API workflow action contract and hosted API CI/API E2E with zero action-runtime deprecation annotations.
